# Plural form parses, type-checks, and compiles.

sngl check app.sngl
stdout 'app.sngl: ok'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:i18n"
import app "sngl:app"

output { go { bubbletea } }

component main node {
    var count = 5
    var msg = $"You have {count, plural, one{message} other{messages}}"
    text(value=msg)
}

app.window {
    main
}
